name: get_editor_state
description: Overview of the open Realot editor: project name, whether the game is playing, selected entity ids, entity count, available component types.

name: list_entities
description: List every entity in the current scene (id, name, tag, active, component types, x/y position).

name: get_entity
description: Full data of one entity: all components with every property.

name: create_entity
description: Create an entity. 'components' maps a component type (e.g. SpriteRenderer, Collider2D, Rigidbody2D, Script) to its properties. A Transform is always added. Undoable with undo. Values are validated: wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum values (e.g. Light.type), out-of-range numbers, bad hex colors and values the engine would silently clamp are rejected with a message listing every problem and the allowed values; nothing is changed on error.

name: update_component
description: Change properties of an existing component on an entity (only properties the component already has). Use get_entity first to see them. Values are validated: wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum values (e.g. Light.type), out-of-range numbers, bad hex colors and values the engine would silently clamp are rejected with a message listing every problem and the allowed values; nothing is changed on error.

name: add_component
description: Add a component to an entity. Values are validated: wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum values (e.g. Light.type), out-of-range numbers, bad hex colors and values the engine would silently clamp are rejected with a message listing every problem and the allowed values; nothing is changed on error.

name: remove_component
description: Remove a component (not Transform) from an entity.

name: delete_entities
description: Delete entities by id (same as pressing Delete in the editor). Undoable.

name: select_entities
description: Select entities in the editor so the user sees them in the Inspector.

name: list_scripts
description: Names of all scripts in the project.

name: get_script
description: Source code of a script.

name: write_script
description: Create or overwrite a script's source code. Entities already using this script get the new code too. Reports syntax errors.

name: attach_script
description: Attach an existing script to an entity (adds a Script component).

name: set_playing
description: Start or stop play mode (opens the game in the play window). For testing prefer play_restart (fresh start, waits until ready) and play_input.

name: get_console
description: Recent editor/play console lines (logs, warnings, script errors). Use clear_console before a test so only new lines remain.

name: screenshot
description: Image of the EDITOR scene viewport (with gizmos, grid and selection) — for checking level layout while building. To see the real game as a player does, use play_screenshot.

name: undo
description: Undo the last editor change.

name: redo
description: Redo the last undone change.

name: save_project
description: Save now (browser autosave slot, and the .realot file if one is being kept up to date).

name: list_assets
description: List imported images and audio without returning binary data, grouped like the editor's Project folders: Sprites, Animation Clips (uploaded animation frames) and Tiles (tileset images), plus Audio. Use the keys in SpriteRenderer, AudioSource, animation clips, and tilesets.

kind.description: animation (alias frame) = Animation Clips folder; tile = Tiles folder.

name: begin_asset_upload
description: Start uploading a custom asset: a sprite, audio file, animation source, tileset image, or a loose image for the Animation Clips folder (purpose 'frame-asset') or Tiles folder (purpose 'tile-asset'). Then send sequential base64 chunks with append_asset_upload_chunk and finish with complete_asset_upload. The editor must be open and connected. Maximum 20 MiB per file. Purpose 'project-zip' (a .realot/.zip project, max 20 MiB) REPLACES the entire open project and asks the person at the editor to confirm. Animation uploads land in the Animation Clips folder; tileset uploads land in the Tiles folder.

entity_id.description: Required for animation-image, animation-zip, animation-gif, and animation-sheet.

role.description: Required for tileset-tile; use a role from list_tilesets.

group.description: Optional heading to list a frame-asset or tile-asset under in its folder.

name: append_asset_upload_chunk
description: Send one base64-encoded binary chunk for an active asset upload. Chunks must be independent base64 strings, sequential from index 0. Use the chunk size returned by begin_asset_upload; retrying the same index and data is safe.

name: complete_asset_upload
description: Validate and import all received bytes using the editor's native import pipeline. Call only after every chunk has been accepted.

name: cancel_asset_upload
description: Discard a staged upload before it is imported.

name: rename_asset
description: Rename an imported sprite, animation frame, tile or audio asset while preserving its key and references.

name: delete_asset
description: Delete an imported asset. If the asset is referenced by scenes or prefabs, the first call reports those references; set confirm=true only when it is acceptable to leave them unresolved.

confirm.description: Explicitly confirm deletion even when references exist.

name: list_animations
description: List animation clips and ordered frame keys for every entity in the active scene.

name: open_editor_panel
description: Open the animation editor, tileset editor, physics-layer panel, or navigation-area panel. Animation and tileset panels need the matching entity_id.

name: create_animation_clip
description: Create an empty animation clip on an entity, adding SpriteAnimation if needed, and open it in the animation editor.

name: update_animation_clip
description: Change an animation clip name, frame rate, loop setting, or collider override. Set collider_override to null to remove the override.

name: delete_animation_clip
description: Delete one animation clip from its entity. The remaining clips and frames are preserved.

name: move_animation_frame
description: Reorder an animation frame by moving it from one zero-based position to another.

name: delete_animation_frame
description: Remove one zero-based frame position from an animation clip without deleting the underlying imported asset.

name: list_tilesets
description: List tilesets, tile dimensions, and sprite keys assigned to each role.

name: update_tileset
description: Edit a tileset name, tile dimensions, or selected role-to-sprite assignments. Set a slot to null to clear it.

slots.description: Partial role-to-sprite-key map; use null to clear a role.

name: add_animation_frames
description: Add images that are already in the project (sprites, Animation Clips frames, or Tiles) to an animation clip as frames. Use list_assets for keys and list_animations for entity/clip ids. Optional index inserts at that position instead of appending. Undoable.

name: set_tileset_slot
description: Put an existing project image (sprite, animation frame or tile) in one slot of a Tileset, or clear the slot with asset_key null. Roles come from list_tilesets.

name: slice_asset_into_tileset
description: Cut one existing project image (for example an uploaded sprite) into a 4x4 grid and fill all 16 Tileset slots with the pieces. The pieces are saved in the Tiles folder under the tileset's name. Undoable.

name: list_tilemaps
description: List Tilemap entities, their assigned tileset entity, painted cell count, and up to 500 grid coordinates.

name: paint_tilemap
description: Paint or erase grid cells on a Tilemap. Coordinates are integer cell columns and rows, not world coordinates. Undoable.

name: list_navigation_worlds
description: List NavWorld2D entities with bounds, cell size, painted cell counts, and navigation settings.

name: paint_navigation_cells
description: Paint walkable or blocked navigation cells, restore baked walkability, or set/clear navigation area indices. Coordinates are integer grid columns and rows. Undoable.

name: update_navigation_world
description: Edit NavWorld2D bounds, cell size, obstacle threshold, diagonal movement, dynamic mode, or all 16 area costs. Cell changes invalidate the baked runtime cache.

name: list_navigation_areas
description: List the 16 named navigation area slots and their indices.

name: set_navigation_area_name
description: Rename one navigation area slot. Slot 0 is the default Ground area and cannot be cleared.

name: list_physics_layers
description: List all 16 named physics layers and their indices.

name: set_physics_layer_name
description: Rename one of the 16 physics layer slots. Slot 0 is the default layer and cannot be cleared.

name: set_collider_layer_filter
description: Set a Collider2D's physics layer and the layer indices it collides with. Use list_physics_layers to map names to indices.

name: set_editor_tool
description: Choose a viewport tool and optionally select its Tilemap, NavWorld2D, or StrokePath entity so the user can continue painting in the editor.

name: update_entity
description: Rename an entity or change its tag, active flag, or hierarchy folder. Use update_component for Transform and other components.

patch.description: Any of: name (string), tag (string; new tags are added to the registry), active (boolean), folderId (string|null)

name: list_scenes
description: List every scene in the project and which one is active.

name: create_scene
description: Create a new scene (with a Main Camera). Switches to it unless switch=false.

switch.description: Switch to the new scene (default true)

name: switch_scene
description: Make another scene the active one in the editor.

name: rename_scene
description: Rename a scene.

name: delete_scene
description: Delete a scene. Cannot be undone, so the first call only reports what would be deleted; repeat with confirm=true. A project must keep one scene.

name: list_tags
description: List the project tag registry.

name: add_tag
description: Add a tag to the registry.

name: delete_tag
description: Remove a tag from the registry (Untagged cannot be removed).

name: list_prefabs
description: List prefabs in the project.

name: create_prefab
description: Create a prefab from an entity and link that entity to it.

name: instantiate_prefab
description: Place a new instance of a prefab in the active scene.

name: rename_prefab
description: Rename a prefab.

name: delete_prefab
description: Delete a prefab from the catalogue; existing instances become unlinked. First call reports impact; repeat with confirm=true.

name: list_folders
description: List Hierarchy folders in the active scene (id, name, parentId).

name: create_folder
description: Create a Hierarchy folder, optionally nested in another. Put entities in it with update_entity folderId.

parent_id.description: Parent folder id (omit for top level)

name: rename_folder
description: Rename a Hierarchy folder.

name: move_folder
description: Nest a folder inside another folder, or move it to the top level (omit parent_id). Cycles are refused.

parent_id.description: New parent folder id; omit for top level

name: delete_folder
description: Delete a folder. Its entities and sub-folders move up one level; nothing inside is deleted.

name: update_prefab
description: Push an instance's current data to its prefab and to every non-overridden instance across all scenes (the editor's Update Prefab).

id.description: Entity id of a prefab instance

name: revert_prefab
description: Reset a prefab instance to its prefab's data, discarding overrides.

id.description: Entity id of a prefab instance

name: unpack_prefab
description: Unlink an instance from its prefab, keeping its current data.

id.description: Entity id of a prefab instance

name: duplicate_scene
description: Duplicate a scene (deep copy) and add it to the project. Does not switch to it.

name: delete_script
description: Delete a script from the project and clear it from objects using it. Cannot be undone, so the first call reports usage; repeat with confirm=true.

name: set_script_enabled
description: Enable or disable the Script component on an entity without removing it.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

name: bake_navworld
description: Bake a NavWorld2D from the scene's colliders (the editor's Bake button). Reports walkable and blocked cell counts.

id.description: Entity id with a NavWorld2D component

name: set_paused
description: Pause or resume the running game in real time. The game must be playing (see set_playing). Note: play_input and play_step leave the game paused; call this with paused=false to let it run on its own.

paused.description: true to pause, false to resume

name: export_game
description: Build the game as a standalone HTML5 or PWA ZIP. By default it also downloads the ZIP in the editor's browser; read the bytes with read_export_chunk. APK builds are not supported through MCP.

download.description: Also download in the editor browser (default true)

name: read_export_chunk
description: Read one base64 chunk of the last export_game ZIP.

name: release_export
description: Free the memory held by the last export_game result.

name: download_project_zip
description: Save the whole project as a .realot ZIP, downloaded in the editor's browser (File > Save Project without a file handle).

name: get_engine_guide
description: START HERE when building a game. Returns a short, accurate guide to the workflow, coordinates (+Y is down), script lifecycle and globals, and how to test. Optional topic: testing, scripting, physics, assets, ui.

name: describe_component
description: Show every field of a component type with its type, default value, allowed values (enums) and numeric range. Use before create_entity/add_component/update_component so the first call is valid.

type.description: Component type, e.g. Rigidbody2D, Collider2D, SpriteRenderer, Light, CharacterController (see componentTypes in get_editor_state).

name: check_project
description: Static health check of the whole project (all scenes): missing/duplicate Main Camera, scripts with syntax errors, Script components pointing at missing scripts, missing sprite/audio assets, Rigidbody2D without Collider2D, unattached scripts. Run it after building and before testing.

name: duplicate_entities
description: Copy one or more entities with all components (like Ctrl+D). Copies are offset so they do not overlap; use count to make a row of copies (e.g. coins, platforms, enemies). Undoable.

count.description: Number of copies of each (default 1, max 50). Copy n is offset n times.

name: clear_console
description: Empty the editor Console so the next test run starts with a clean log.

name: play_restart
description: Start the game fresh from the current scenes and scripts (reloads the Play window if it is open) and wait until it is running. The game is left PAUSED so tests are deterministic: advance it with play_input or play_step. Returns the initial state and a screenshot. Needs the browser to allow the Play popup.

settle_frames.description: Frames to simulate right after boot (default 10) so physics settles.

name: play_input
description: Play the game like a user, in one call: press keys, click/tap, drag, wait, take screenshots, read values and ASSERT results. Actions run in order on a fixed 60 fps time step, so results are repeatable. Returns per-action results, failed assertions, new script errors, final state and the screenshots. Limits: 120 actions, 4 screenshots, about 15 seconds of real time per call (long tests: split into several calls; the game keeps its state between calls). Typical: [{type:'hold',keys:['right'],seconds:1},{type:'assert',expression:"findFirst('Player').x > 100"},{type:'screenshot'}].

items.description: One step of a playtest. 'type' decides which other fields apply.

type.description: key_press {key, frames?=6}: tap a key. hold {keys[], frames|seconds}: hold keys down then release. key_down/key_up {key}: manual control (released automatically at the end). wait {frames|seconds}: let the game run. click {x,y|entity, space?, button?, frames?}: mouse click. tap: same with a touch finger. drag/swipe {from:{x,y|entity}, to:{x,y}, frames?}. mouse_*/touch_* are the low-level pieces. scene_load {name}. screenshot {label?, max_width?}: capture the game (max 4 per call). inspect {entity} or {filter:{name,tag,component}}: read state. eval {expression}: evaluate JS with the script globals and report the value. assert {expression, message?}: fails the test if the expression is falsy.

key.description: Key name: left/right/up/down/space/enter/escape/shift, a letter or digit, or a code like ArrowLeft, KeyA, Space.

keys.description: For hold: several keys at once, e.g. ["right","space"].

frames.description: Frames of game time (60 = one second).

entity.description: Entity id or name in the running game (click/tap/inspect).

space.description: Coordinate space for x/y. Default screen (game-view pixels). Use world for scene coordinates.

from.description: A point. Give x and y, or entity (id or name) to aim at that entity's position.

entity.description: Entity id or name in the running game.

to.description: A point. Give x and y, or entity (id or name) to aim at that entity's position.

entity.description: Entity id or name in the running game.

expression.description: JavaScript expression for eval/assert. Script globals are in scope: findFirst("Player").x, global.score, input, scene, time ... Use 'return' if you write several statements.

filter.description: For inspect without an entity: {name, tag, component, active_only}.

continue_on_error.description: Keep going if this action errors (default: the run stops).

restart.description: Start the game fresh first (same as calling play_restart). Default false: continue the running game.

keep_paused.description: Default true: the game stays paused after the test. Pass false to let it run in real time afterwards.

name: play_step
description: Advance the paused game by N frames or seconds of game time (60 frames = 1 second) without any input, e.g. to let enemies move or physics settle. Optionally returns a screenshot.

name: play_screenshot
description: Image of the actual running game exactly as a player sees it (the Play window), unlike screenshot which shows the editor's scene viewport with gizmos. Includes HUD text and lighting.

name: play_get_state
description: Live state of the running game: scene, frame, game time, `global` values, recent errors, and entities with position, velocity (Rigidbody2D) and the variables scripts stored on this (this.hp, this.score...). Filter to keep it small.

component.description: Only entities that have this component, e.g. Rigidbody2D.

name: play_get_entity
description: One entity of the running game in full: every component field plus script variables.

name: play_eval
description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression inside the running game with the script globals in scope (findFirst, findAll, global, input, scene, time, physics...). Read anything: findFirst('Player').hp. Change anything to set up a situation: (findFirst('Player').x = 900). Returns the value.

name: play_get_errors
description: Script and engine errors raised in the running game since it started (message, script, line, frame). Empty means the game ran cleanly.
